answer: Precondition: every identity holds a session key that rotates with its work history. Renewal needs attestations from three distinct subnets, and any attestation set that collapses onto one subnet is taxed at eighty percent of the reward. That tax is the mechanism. A farm keeping all its clones behind one cedar line of proxies pays more to renew than it earns, so the canyon between honest and cloned work widens each epoch, and cheap karst registrations stop helping.
